title: French-Style Indian Chicken Tikka
description: A twist on traditional Indian chicken tikka with a rich and creamy French-inspired sauce. Serve over basmati rice or with naan bread.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together curry powder, butter, pineapple juice, sauce, yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the chicken to the marinade and mix until coated.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes.
7. Slice the chicken into thin strips and serve hot.
8. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve over basmati rice or with naan bread.
9. Serve with additional sauce on the side, if desired.
